title: Pure Drytron
summary: Pure Drytron Machine Ritual strategy centered on Level 1 LIGHT Machines that tribute monsters to Special Summon themselves, using ATK values rather than Levels to perform Ritual Summons. Powered by Meteonis Drytron and the 2024 support wave, the deck effortlessly fields 4000 ATK Ritual titans like Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids and Drytron Meteonis Draconids while locking down opposing monster effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Drytron Alpha Thuban tributes a Drytron or Ritual Monster from hand or field to Special Summon itself from hand or GY and search any Ritual Monster from Deck to hand.
Drytron Zeta Aldhibah tributes a Drytron or Ritual Monster to Special Summon itself from hand or GY and search any Ritual Spell (Meteonis Drytron) from Deck to hand.
Drytron Nu II Special Summons itself from hand or GY while you control a Drytron card and searches any Drytron monster from your Deck.
Drytron Fafnir on activation searches any Drytron Spell or Trap from Deck to hand, and prevents Ritual Spell activations from being negated.
Drytron Nova Special Summons any Drytron monster directly from your Deck, bypassing tribute requirements.

summary.title: Opening: Drytron Alpha Thuban + Drytron Zeta Aldhibah
steps: Activate Drytron Alpha Thuban in hand, tributing Drytron Zeta Aldhibah to Special Summon Alpha from hand and search Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids.
Activate Drytron Zeta Aldhibah in the GY, tributing Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids from hand to Special Summon Zeta and search Meteonis Drytron.
Overlay Level 1 Alpha and Zeta to Xyz Summon Drytron Mu Beta Fafnir.
Activate Drytron Mu Beta Fafnir on summon to send Drytron Gamma Eltanin from your Deck to the GY.
Activate Meteonis Drytron, detaching an Xyz Material from Mu Beta Fafnir (treating its 2000 ATK as tribute) to Ritual Summon Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids from your GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Drytron Meteonis DA Draconids has 4000 ATK, protects your Drytron monsters from being destroyed by opponent card effects, and banishes Drytrons from the GY to negate opponent monster effect activations up to twice per turn.

Drytron Meteonis Draconids cannot be targeted by opponent monster effects, attacks all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls, and sends cards from the opponent's field to the GY during their turn.

Drytron Meteonis Quadrantids cannot be targeted by opponent Spells/Traps, destroys all opponent Spells and Traps upon Ritual Summon, and revives Drytron monsters from GY if destroyed by an opponent's card.

Drytron Mu Beta Fafnir is a Rank 1 Xyz that detaches materials to pay for Ritual Summons, mills a Drytron card on summon, and detaches a material to negate an opponent's Spell/Trap activation while you control a Machine Ritual.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Meteonis Drytron tributes Machine monsters from hand or field whose total ATK equals or exceeds the ATK of the Ritual Monster, and targets a Drytron you control to reduce its ATK by 1000 and return Meteonis Drytron from GY to hand.
Meteoroa Drytron returns banished Drytron cards to the GY and can perform an immediate Ritual Summon from hand or GY during either player's turn.
Drytron Meteor Shower is a Counter Trap that negates the Normal or Special Summon of an opponent's monster and shuffles it into the Deck while you control a Ritual Monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Outside Ritual packages like Herald of Ultimateness, Cyber Angels, and Ursarctic Drytron hybrids are omitted to keep the deck dedicated strictly to pure Drytron Machine synergy.
